maddeler.e:
ينتقلون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِلُونَ (yantaqilūna) /jan.ta.qi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# يُنْتَقَلُونَ (yuntaqalūna) /jun.ta.qa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
